note: Captured from Composio's live GMAIL_FETCH_EMAILS and GMAIL_FETCH_MESSAGE_BY_MESSAGE_ID (version 20261105_00) on 2026-11-07, read-only. Every string that was mail or named a person is replaced by a placeholder of the same length, so keys, nesting, header names, MIME types, system labels and sizes are Composio's and nothing is anybody's mail. `envelope` is the execute answer around `data`. `full` is one message as a listing returns it with include_payload and verbose true; `metadata` is one with both false; `byId` is one message read by its id. Regenerate rather than hand-edit.
